d: Iran has unveiled footage of an underground military drone facility, showcasing dozens of unmanned systems and an upgraded Arash drone that Tehran says can carry a 100-kilogram warhead, double its previous capacity. Iranian Army Chief General Amir Hatami says Iran is expanding drone production, training and operational capabilities. Tehran has also warned that enemy vessels entering waters near the Strait of Hormuz and the Sea of Oman could be targeted. Hem Kaur Saroya tells you more.
